registration_note: Committed before any game in the population kicked off: the first V2 FINAL_PREGAME-eligible kickoff is 2026-10-08T23:00Z, and no prospective quote, settlement or outcome was read to write this file.

retrospective_basis.use: Context only. The retrospective sample is never pooled with prospective rows and is never re-evaluated.

population.rule: every game with at least one V2 ledger row of kind FINAL_PREGAME recorded strictly before its kickoff_utc, kickoff_utc on or after 2026-10-08T12:00:00Z; the game's row is the LAST such FINAL_PREGAME row by recorded_at; the CONTROL tier (side, strength) is copied from that row verbatim and is never recomputed, re-derived or backfilled
population.no_final_pregame: a game without a FINAL_PREGAME row is outside the population and is counted as a pipeline coverage miss (NO_FINAL_PREGAME), never imputed from a PUBLICATION row
population.pooling: prospective rows only; never pooled with the retrospective study

capture.source: PROSPECTIVE_CAPTURE: the CFB research conductor's own read of Kalshi's public market data (GET /markets, series KXNCAAFGAME), appended to the research-signals branch capture/<season>/quotes.jsonl at capture time; no other source is an entry
capture.catch_up: a slot whose moment passed without an attempt is attempted on the next cycle while the window is still open; the captured_at actually recorded is what the window rule reads
capture.kickoff_reference: kickoff_utc of the game's V2 FINAL_PREGAME row (ESPN schedule kickoff)

health_statuses.CAPTURE_OK: at least one valid executable quote of the side in the window
health_statuses.CAPTURE_PENDING: the window has not closed and no valid quote yet
health_statuses.MARKET_NOT_OFFERED: an attempt in the window succeeded against Kalshi and no KXNCAAFGAME market exists for the game (market absence, not our failure)
health_statuses.QUOTE_NOT_EXECUTABLE: the market existed but no side ask was a whole cent in [1,99] with status active/open
health_statuses.PRICE_1_00: the side's ask was $1.00 (no offer below a dollar)
health_statuses.ORIENTATION_FAILURE: markets existed but the frozen matcher could not resolve which ESPN team each pays on
health_statuses.CAPTURE_SYSTEM_FAILURE: the window closed with no successful attempt (our request failed or no attempt ran); never reported as market absence

entry.contract: the CONTROL team's own KXNCAAFGAME market, YES side, one research contract
entry.rule: LAST valid executable YES ask of that market with kickoff-180min <= captured_at <= kickoff-60min; missing stays missing (ENTRY_QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE); never searched outside the window; NO is never 1 - YES
entry.valid_quote: identical to the frozen market protocol: ask p with 0.01 <= p <= 0.99, p*100 an integer (1e-9 tolerance), status in {active, open} when recorded, captured strictly before kickoff
entry.orientation: the frozen market protocol's matcher (control_market.quotes.orient_markets) against the ESPN schedule; unresolved or conflicting -> excluded before any outcome is read
entry.price_cap: none: every available price is included

fees: identical to the frozen market protocol: kalshi.fee_schedule.KALSHI_FEE_SCHEDULE_2026_07_07_TAKER at the captured entry price; uncomputable -> FEE_UNAVAILABLE, never 0
settlement: $1 iff the CONTROL team won; final score from the production ESPN game log; missing score or tie -> SETTLEMENT_UNAVAILABLE
economics: identical to the frozen market protocol: outlay = entry + fee; fee_adjusted_pnl = settlement - outlay; ROI = sum(fee_adjusted_pnl) / sum(outlay); break-even = mean(outlay)

H1.wording: MODERATE CONTROL, home and away pooled, purchased at the frozen PRIMARY_60_180 executable game-winner ask at all available prices, has fee-adjusted ROI > 0.
H1.primary_metric: pooled fee-adjusted ROI on outlay over rows with entry, fee and settlement
never: excluding a team, conference, opponent or price

H2.wording: STRONG CONTROL priced below 85¢ underperforms its fee-adjusted break-even rate.
H2.primary_metric: realized CONTROL win rate minus fee-adjusted break-even rate (mean outlay) over rows with entry, fee and settlement and entry ask < 0.85; fee-adjusted ROI reported beside it
H2.status: tracked prospectively; not a rule of any kind
never: changing the 85 cent threshold after outcomes

research_status.automatic: code may emit only VALUE_WATCH or REVIEW_REQUIRED for MODERATE CONTROL; EDGE_CONFIRMED, NO_EDGE or INSUFFICIENT_DATA for it appear only from a reviewed entry in decisions.json
research_status.review_gate_MODERATE: REVIEW_REQUIRED when (H1 n >= 30 AND ROI > 0 AND capture coverage healthy AND football coherent) OR H1 n >= 50; otherwise VALUE_WATCH
research_status.capture_coverage_healthy: among MODERATE population games whose primary window closed, CAPTURE_OK / (CAPTURE_OK + ORIENTATION_FAILURE + CAPTURE_SYSTEM_FAILURE) >= 0.90 (market-side statuses are not our failure and are excluded from the denominator)
research_status.football_coherent: Wilson 95% upper bound of the prospective MODERATE football win rate (every settled MODERATE population game, priced or not) >= 0.6658 (the lowest frozen development/validation MODERATE win rate)
research_status.edge_criteria_for_review: H1 n >= 50 AND ROI > 0 AND bootstrap 95% ROI lower bound > 0 AND each of HOME/AWAY MODERATE >= 10 rows AND rows from >= 3 distinct season weeks AND no protocol deviation recorded; meeting them sets edge_criteria_met=true on a REVIEW_REQUIRED status, never EDGE_CONFIRMED

forbidden: changing any window, slot, threshold, tier, checkpoint or gate after the first prospective outcome
a probability, fair price or bet-up-to price derived from these rows
a stake, bankroll, Kelly fraction, unit size or automatic order of any kind
recommendation language in any published field
promoting a status by code beyond REVIEW_REQUIRED
